title.narrative: PROTECTS V2 – UPSCALE (Upscaling Programs and Services to the Communities Affected by and Living with HIV to End the Epidemic) - Philippines (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Philippines, HIV, Pilipinas Shell Foundation, Inc. (PSFI Philippines)This program has the following goals: Decreasing number of annual new infections. 95% of key populations with preventive behaviors against HIV. 95% of PLHIV diagnosed, of which 95% are on ART, and of which 95% have viral suppression. Increased access of key populaitons and PLHIV to health services. The objectives of this program are: Expand coverage of combination prevention services for key populations. Scale up access and use of HIV Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis. Scale up self-testing and network-based mobilization approaches (index testing and social and sexual network testing). Expand the number and network coverage of Rapid HIV Diagnostic Algortihm (rHIVda) facilities. Enhance treatment adherence and return to care services. Expand viral load testing coverage. Scale up interventions to remove human rights related barriers to HIV services
